description: A single node placed on the diagram canvas.

members.name: BackgroundShape
members.description: Background shape type for perimeter projection. E.g. "rectangle", "ellipse", "diamond".

members.name: Collapsed
members.description: Whether this node is currently collapsed.

members.name: Data
members.description: Node data keyed by property name. (e.g. "name", "attributes", "methods").

members.name: ExpandedHeight
members.description: Height to restore when expanding. Set automatically during collapse.

members.name: GroupId
members.description: Optional group identifier. Nodes with the same GroupId behave as a group.

members.name: H
members.description: Height in pixels.

members.name: Id
members.description: Unique identifier (short Guid, e.g. "a3f8c21b").

members.name: IsCollapsible
members.description: Whether this node can be collapsed/expanded.

members.name: IsLocked
members.description: When true, the node cannot be moved, resized or deleted.

members.name: LayerId
members.description: Optional layer identifier. When null, the node belongs to the default layer.

members.name: Link
members.description: Optional hyperlink target (external URL or page:// link).

members.name: LockedBy
members.description: Reserved for future collaborative editing – who has this node locked.

members.name: ParentGroupId
members.description: Optional group container identifier. When set, the node is rendered only inside that group.

members.name: ParentNodeId
members.description: Optional parent node identifier for nested nodes (containers, packages, pools).

members.name: Ports
members.description: Connection ports on this node. Auto-generated from stencil if empty.

members.name: Rotation
members.description: Rotation in degrees.

members.name: StencilId
members.description: Stencil type identifier – must match a registered stencil definition. (e.g. "uml.class").

members.name: Style
members.description: Visual style overrides for this node.

members.name: SwimlaneColumn
members.description: Column index inside a parent swimlane (-1 when not in a swimlane).

members.name: SwimlaneData
members.description: Swimlane configuration when this node is a swimlane container.

members.name: SwimlaneRow
members.description: Row index inside a parent swimlane (-1 when not in a swimlane).

members.name: W
members.description: Width in pixels.

members.name: X
members.description: X position of the node's top-left corner in pixels.

members.name: Y
members.description: Y position of the node's top-left corner in pixels.

members.name: ZIndex
members.description: Stacking order. Higher value = rendered on top.
